title: Ladies Cigar Event | Ugly Christmas Sweater Edition
seo_title: Ladies Cigar Event: Ugly Christmas Sweater in Ozark, MO
description: This is a holiday-themed ladies cigar night in the lounge at Vineyard Market, with Padron cigars, Kevin's Cocktails, and an ugly Christmas sweater theme (sweaters encouraged). It is for ladies, and tickets are $45; reservations can be made by calling (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
